title: Little Victor and Set
statementMd:
Little Victor adores the sets theory. Let us remind you that a set is a group of numbers where all numbers are pairwise distinct. Today Victor wants to find a set of integers $*S*$ that has the following properties:

- for all $*x*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/89ef1d06c3b43bc6b3f78773237c8d12750a53f8.png) the following inequality holds $*l* ≤ *x* ≤ *r*$;
- $1 ≤ |*S*| ≤ *k*$;
- lets denote the $*i*$-th element of the set $*S*$ as $*s*_{*i*}$; value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/10ed862fb971ad20592a60272392125d155b4a18.png) must be as small as possible.

Help Victor find the described set.

## Input

The first line contains three space-separated integers $*l*, *r*, *k*$ $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ 10^{12}; 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(10^{6}, *r* - *l* + 1))$.

## Output

Print the minimum possible value of $*f*(*S*)$. Then print the cardinality of set $|*S*|$. Then print the elements of the set in any order.

If there are multiple optimal sets, you can print any of them.

## Note

Operation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b364f2e04c665b78b924ec10666327a4ef4635bc.png) represents the operation of bitwise exclusive OR. In other words, it is the XOR operation.
statementZhMd:
小维克多非常喜欢集合论。提醒一下，集合是一个由数字组成的群组，其中任意两个数字都不相同。今天，维克多想要找到一个整数集合 $*S*$，使其满足以下性质：

- 对于所有 $*x*$ ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/89ef1d06c3b43bc6b3f78773237c8d12750a53f8.png)，不等式 $*l* ≤ *x* ≤ *r*$ 成立；
- $1 ≤ |*S*| ≤ *k*$；
- 设集合 $*S*$ 的第 $*i*$ 个元素为 $*s*_{*i*}$，值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/10ed862fb971ad20592a60272392125d155b4a18.png) 必须尽可能小。

请帮助维克多找到满足上述条件的集合。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 $*l*, *r*, *k*$ $(1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ 10^{12}; 1 ≤ *k* ≤ *min*(10^{6}, *r* - *l* + 1))$。

## 输出格式

输出 $*f*(*S*)$ 的最小可能值。然后输出集合 $|*S*|$ 的大小。最后以任意顺序输出集合中的元素。

如果存在多个最优集合，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

运算 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b364f2e04c665b78b924ec10666327a4ef4635bc.png) 表示按位异或运算。换句话说，这是 XOR 运算。
